attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "The empty/whitespace check on PixelId/TrackingID/ContainerID was dropped (now only checks settings is not null), so sites that never configured Facebook Pixel/Google Analytics/Tag Manager will start unconditionally emitting broken tracking scripts (e.g. fbq('init','')) on every page across all tenants using these modules."}

reason: The empty/whitespace check on PixelId/TrackingID/ContainerID was dropped (now only checks settings is not null), so sites that never configured Facebook Pixel/Google Analytics/Tag Manager will start unconditionally emitting broken tracking scripts (e.g. fbq('init','')) on every page across all tenants using these modules.
